title: Eisenhower's farewell warning about the military-industrial complex

tellings.quote: Well, it's exactly what Eisenhower described when he went out of office in ' 61 in January of ' 61 when he left and Jack Kennedy came in and he said, "Beware of the military-industrial complex.

plain: Steven Greer, an activist who argues that UFO secrets are held by a global cabal, tells Michels that what he describes is exactly what President Eisenhower warned of. Greer points to Eisenhower's farewell address of January 1961, given as he left office and John F. Kennedy came in. Greer sums up its message as: "Beware of the military-industrial complex." The speech warned of the growing power of the military and the arms industry. Greer reads that warning as a description of the secret network he says now keeps UFO knowledge hidden. The connection to UFOs is Greer's reading, not something he says the speech states.
